properties.content:

Nearest City: Stamford, CT
Incident Type: UNKNOWN SHEEN
Material: UNKNOWN OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
REPORT OF A DISCOVERY OF OIL LEAKING INTO THE SOIL, INTO AN UNDERGROUND STREAM AND THE MILL RIVER (AKA RIPPOWAM RIVER) WHICH LEADS TO LONG ISLAND SOUND. THERE IS AN ABANDONED 550 GALLON OIL TANK THAT HAD 40 INCHES OF OILY, HIGH SHEEN-ED WATER IN IT. ONE WEEK LATER IT HAD 38 INCHES. THE TANK IS APPROXIMATELY 80 YEARS OLD. THERE IS ALSO A 13 " DEEP, 11 FT. X 5 FT. SOLID CEMENT SLAB ON TOP OF IT. DOWNHILL FROM THIS IS AN UNDERGROUND STREAM THAT IS CLOSE TO THE SURFACE AND EXPOSED UNDER A GRATE. THIS LOCATION HAS A THICK OIL ON THE TOP OF THE WATER THAT LEADS TO THE MILL RIVER. ADD TO THIS, 20 FEET BEHIND THE OIL TANK IS A HAND DUG WELL THAT IS ONLY 20 FEET DEEP, AND IS EVEN CLOSER TO THE RIVER WHERE THERE IS ALSO A SHEEN NEAR THIS WATER SUPPLY TO THE HOUSE AND ON THE ROCKS NEXT TO THE RIVER. IT IS UNKNOWN AT THIS POINT IF IT IS THIS LEAKY OIL TANK OR IF IT HAS MIGRATED FROM NEIGHBORS OR SOMETHING UPSTREAM.

Report Details

Nearest City: Eaton, IN
Location: SOUTH SIDE OF MISSISSINEWA RIVER UNDER THE ROMY STREET BRIDGE 800 SOUTH ROMY
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.343489, -85.347557 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 50 gallons
Report Description
*****WEB REPORT***** THE TOWN OF EATON (INDIANA) IS IN THE PROCESS OF DIGGING A TRENCH TO REPLACE A LEAKING WATER LINE. THE COMPANY DOING THE DIGGING IS DELAWARE CONSTRUCTION. THEY WERE DIGGING ON THE EAST SIDE OF THE ROMY STREET BRIDGE GOING OVER THE MISSISSINEWA RIVER ON ROCKTENN COMPANY PROPERTY WHEN THEY UNCOVERED A 20"-24" TILE PIPE. UPON SHOVEL-DIGGING AROUND THE LINE A PORTION OF THE PIPE BROKE OUT AND WATER STARTED FLOWING OUT. PUMPS WERE BROUGHT IN TO PUMP OUT THE PIT AND THEN BLACK PETROLEUM STARTED FLOWING OUT. BEFORE THE PUMPS COULD BE STOPPED, ABOUT 20-50 GALLONS OF OIL AND WATER HAD BEEN PUMPED INTO A PORTION OF THE RIVER. BOOMS WERE PUT INTO PLACE TO CAPTURE THE OIL. IDEM HAS BEEN INVOLVED SINCE ABOUT 4PM WEDNESDAY. ENVIRONMENTAL REMEDIATION SERVICES HAVE BEEN HERE SINCE MIDNIGHT PUMPING OUT THE PIT TO TRY AND DETERMINE THE CAUSE OF THE FLOW AND THE OIL. NO OIL BESIDES THE 20-50 GALLONS HAS REACHED THE RIVER. ERS IS CONTINUING TO PUMP AND WE ARE WORKING WITH IDEM TO COME UP WITH A SOLUTION. ERS WILL ALSO BE SKIMMING THE TOP OF THE AFFECTED RIVER AREAS TO CAPTURE ANY OIL
